mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a quote for a bedroom and bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, you should verify your property lines, locate your septic or sewer access, and determine your household goals. Gather your property survey to see where setback boundaries lie, and check any homeowners association guidelines regarding exterior additions. It is also helpful to clarify how the suite will be used—such as whether you need aging-in-place features like a curb-less shower or walk-in closet space. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms uses these project goals and property constraints during the initial consultation to recommend practical structural and layout options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify HOA rules, establish your budget, and define your needs, such as aging-in-place accessibility or specific storage requirements.
